== Overview ==

The owner's community_archive server launch archive thread describes Exordion as a Brazilian 8.0 global server with two worlds, staged experience, shared experience bonuses, tasks, raids, an anti-bot client, and custom quality-of-life systems. Use the official site and owner thread below for current account, client, rules, and launch information.

Players searching for '''Exordion''' usually want the official website, client download path, rules, rates, and whether the world is still active. See:
